0.comment: I. Ivanovna N.: Hexenzirkel letter (the Windblume prophecy)
0.content: During Windblume's Breath (3.5, an event), Collei and Sucrose investigated a prophecy found in Mondstadt, built on four descriptions (a flower not of this world, a guide who will never get lost, one who would never lie, a legend that never ends) and pointing to the Lantern of Utmost Joy. Scarlett, a successor of J, admitted slipping it into a storybook. Alice explained that it was a letter the witches sent to J, Ivanovna, the day before her wedding, asking her to come and see them again; the four descriptions stand for Rhinedottir, Nicole, Alice and M (Andersdotter).

1.comment: I. Ivanovna N.: Pulcinella as her pupil
1.content: The Domovoy Mirko applied to the Fatui early in the Tsaritsa's reign, after the Cataclysm, and was told to report to the Mayor, Ivanovna. He learned politics from her, struggling at first to keep her pace, and succeeded to her offices as the Harbinger Pulcinella.

2.comment: I. Ivanovna N.: Snezhnograd Veche founding
2.content: Created by the Tsaritsa in the sixth year of the 799th Cycle to handle administration after the fae princes withdrew. Ivanovna was its first chairperson and Speaker. See the Veche's own entry for its present state.
